name: Gomi Mitai na Otona
source:
I want to die.

As I go on living...

I don't know

how to.

But then again... I suppose I am alive.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240228203721/https://ahito.com/game/boyslove/big/gomimitaina/]official website[/url]]
translation:
我想死。

可就这么苟活下去……

我甚至不知道

该怎么去死。

话虽如此……我大概还是活着吧。

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240228203721/https://ahito.com/game/boyslove/big/gomimitaina/]官方网站[/url]]
